cards.title: while loops
cards.body: A `while` loop repeats as long as its condition is true. Something inside must change, or it never stops.

hi.title: while loops
hi.body: `while` loop tab tak repeat karta hai jab tak uski condition true hai. Andar kuch badalna chahiye, warna woh kabhi nahi rukta.

cards.title: break

hi.title: break
hi.body: `break` loop se turant bahar nikal jaata hai.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: It should print 1, 2, 4 … up to 64, but prints 1 forever. Tap the bug.

bug.fix: `n * 2` works out a value and throws it away, so `n` never changes. Line 4 should be `n = n * 2;`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Isse 1, 2, 4 … 64 tak print karna chahiye, par yeh hamesha 1 print karta rehta hai. Bug par tap karo.
hi.fix: `n * 2` ek value nikalta hai aur phenk deta hai, isliye `n` kabhi nahi badalta. Line 4 `n = n * 2;` honi chahiye.

check.question: What does this print?
check.explanation: The loop stops when `n > 0` is first false, at 0. The `console.log` is after the loop, so it runs once.

hi.question: Yeh kya print karega?
hi.explanation: Loop tab rukta hai jab `n > 0` pehli baar false hota hai, yaani 0 par. `console.log` loop ke baad hai, isliye ek hi baar chalta hai.

exercise.prompt: Read N and count down from N to 1, one number per line, then print `Liftoff!`. Use a `while` loop.
exercise.promptHi: N padho aur N se 1 tak ulti ginti karo, har line mein ek number, phir `Liftoff!` print karo. `while` loop use karo.
